description: Calculate the PBE+vdW band gap of bulk 2H-MoS2.
user_prompt: Calculate the band gap of bulk MoS2 (2H phase, P6_3/mmc) and report its value in eV.

references: Ramasubramaniam, Naveh & Towe, Phys. Rev. B 84, 205325 (2011)
Han et al., Phys. Rev. B 84, 045409 (2011)
Mak, Lee, Hone, Shan & Heinz, Phys. Rev. Lett. 105, 136805 (2010)
method.modeling: Use bulk 2H-MoS2 in the P6_3/mmc structure and report the indirect fundamental gap from the valence-band maximum at Gamma to the conduction-band minimum along Gamma-K.
method.rationale: The scored value is the 0.92 eV indirect PBE-D2 gap reported by Ramasubramaniam et al. for relaxed bulk MoS2; the same work reports 0.87 eV at experimental lattice parameters and shows that plain PBE overexpands c and gives the wrong conduction-band minimum location. Han et al. independently report a bulk indirect gap of about 0.9 eV and the same Gamma-to-Gamma-K gap character. Mak et al. provide the experimental thickness trend and bulk indirect-gap context, so this benchmark scores the semilocal PBE+vdW underestimate rather than the experimental optical gap.
